title: Ex-Cardinals coach, Titans assistant McGinnis dies

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Ex-Cardinals coach, Titans assistant McGinnis dies
sources.description: Former Tennessee assistant Dave McGinnis, who also served as head coach for the Arizona Cardinals in a decorated career on the NFL sidelines, died at 74 on Monday with his family by his side at Ascension St. Thomas Midtown Hospital, the Titans announced.
